title: Bala Tripura Sundari Maha Anushthan: Entering into the Realm of Sri Vidya
description: अरुणकिरणजालैःरञ्जिताशावकाशाविधृतजपवटीकापुस्तकाभीतिहस्ता।इतरकरवराढ्याफुल्लकल्हारसंस्थानिवसतुहृदिबालानित्यकल्याणशीला।। Shewhosequartersoftheskyaredyedred andcrimsonbythenetworkofherradiantrays, holding a Japa rosary and a book in her hands, one hand in Abhaya Mudra and the other adorned with Vara Mudra, seated upon a fully bloomed lotus — may this Bala, ever of auspicious nature, reside in my heart.

title: Guru Sadhana: The Inner Awakening
description: ध्यानमूलं गुरोर्मूर्तिः पूजामूलं गुरोः पदम् । मंत्रमूलं गुरोर्वाक्यं मोक्षमूलं गुरोः कृपा ॥

title: Ati Rudra Sadhana
description: Ati Rudra Sadhana: Entering into the Realm of ShivaSri Badrika Ashram opens the doors to one of the most intense and sacred sadhanas of the Sanatan tradition. The Ati Rudra Sadhana. Curated by Om Swami and facilitated by Brahmachari Parakh Om, this sadhana unfolds on the consecrated grounds of Sri Badrika Ashram, held sacred by the grace of Mahadev himself.
